ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 65-70% high-intensity white pixels dominant in the central lobe areas, with 30-35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the base, median notch, and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmentation field at the fluke base/notch area. Irregular black mottling and focal spotting along the trailing edge margins. Discrete circular black spots visible in the interior region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 70-80 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serration map across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5 to 12 pixels, creating a highly irregular linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the primary trailing edge transitioning into a sharp concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white and grey pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips and outer lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) highly visible against the black pigmentation fields in the center and trailing edge base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks consistent with interspecific interaction; significant barnacle colonization on the fluke margins causing localized structural relief variations.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique punctate black speckling on the mid-to-upper right lobe; significant jagged 'chip' out of the trailing edge of the left lobe near the mid-point.
